steps.note: the API built this case's state

Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Create one line item for equal-price comparison.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite exactly two vendors so both bids appear in Master QCS.
Submit a 100 bid from the first vendor.
Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Submit the same 100 bid from a different vendor.
Confirm the second vendor's bid was accepted.
End bidding so Master QCS comparison and ranks are available.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid.
Assert that both real vendor columns are present.
Verify the first vendor's quoted rate is 100.
Verify the second vendor's quoted rate is 100.
Verify each line amount and total are calculated correctly.
Check whether the first tied vendor receives the expected best rank.
Check whether the second tied vendor also receives the expected best rank; a displayed rank of 2 exposes the reported defect.
